# Scenario: disabling an unused app stack downs it, removes its apps dir, and
# writes container_removed with project + host-observed compose service keys
# (README Events). Sibling project stays running; failed downs are not covered.

cd git-repo
exec git init -b main
exec git config user.email 'test@apinfra.local'
exec git config user.name 'Test Agent'
exec git add .
exec git commit -m 'feat: container removed baseline'
cd ..

cp .apinfra.template .apinfra
exec sh -c 'echo "repo=file://'$WORK'/git-repo" >> .apinfra'

# --- Cycle 1: both stacks up (baseline). Do not assert added=* — host Docker may
# already have these compose services from a prior local run (added=(none)). ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'container deployed project=e2e-crem-keep containers=web'
stderr 'container deployed project=e2e-crem-drop containers=api,web'
stderr 'done duration='

docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-crem-keep-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-crem-drop-web
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-crem-drop-api
exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-crem-drop
exists $HOME/.events
# Unrelated leftovers on host Docker can emit other container_removed lines.
exec sh -c 'if grep container_removed "$HOME/.events" | grep -q e2e-crem; then exit 1; fi'

cd git-repo
cp ../settings.drop-disabled.yml dev/settings.yml
exec git add dev/settings.yml
exec git commit -m 'chore: disable e2e-crem-drop'
cd ..

# --- Cycle 2: disabled stack downed → container_removed; apps dir gone ---
exec apinfra
stderr 'down unused project=e2e-crem-drop containers=api,web'
stderr 'container removed project=e2e-crem-drop containers=api,web'
stderr 'done duration='

! docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-crem-drop-web
! docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-crem-drop-api
docker-assert-running apinfra_e2e-crem-keep-web
! exists $HOME/infra/apps/e2e-crem-drop

exists $HOME/.events
grep 'container_removed' $HOME/.events
grep '"project":"e2e-crem-drop"' $HOME/.events
grep '"containers":"api,web"' $HOME/.events

-- .apinfra.template --
namespace=dev
repoBranch=main

-- git-repo/dev/settings.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-crem-keep
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9965
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-crem-drop
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9966
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- settings.drop-disabled.yml --
version: "1.0"
projects:
  - name: e2e-crem-keep
    enabled: true
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9965
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none
  - name: e2e-crem-drop
    enabled: false
    proxy:
      inbound:
        port: 9966
      target:
        service:
          name: web
          port: 80
    config:
      cert-issue-type: none

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-crem-keep/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=KEEP"]

-- git-repo/dev/e2e-crem-drop/docker-compose.yml --
services:
  web:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=DROP"]
  api:
    image: hashicorp/http-echo:latest
    command: ["-listen=:80", "-text=API"]

-- .env --
